technical_and_design_decisions: Keep the existing Maven multi-module build structure; migrated Kafka and Rabbit sinks will be packaged as Spring Boot-based Spring Cloud Stream modules with their own Maven modules in the s-c-s repository.
Implement migrated modules against the Spring Cloud Stream binder SPI (@EnableBinding, Binder interface) rather than the legacy XD module model, so U1 and U2 align with the s-c-s programming model.

Implement multi-binder support (U3) by extending the binder resolution mechanism with a BinderFactory/registry that instantiates and caches one binder instance per configured binder type (rabbit, redis, kafka) and resolves each channel to its configured binder via per-channel binding properties.

Use Spring Boot externalized configuration (YAML/properties with relaxed binding) for the external override file (U4), adding a module resolver override hook so module Maven coordinates can be remapped at runtime.
Refactor the Cloud Foundry SPI deployer (U5) onto the CF Java Client (reactor-based API), encapsulating all CF interactions behind a thin adapter so the deployer SPI stays implementation-agnostic.

Support Hadoop distribution selection (U6) through Maven profiles per distribution (e.g., HDP, CDH, MapR, Pivotal HD) plus a runtime classpath/dependency-resolution switch that loads the matching client libraries.

Move header-enricher (U7) into XD proper as a built-in processor module registered in the XD module registry, preserving its existing Spring Integration XML/annotation configuration and option metadata.
Perform the dependency upgrade (U8) centrally in the parent POM/dependency-management BOM, then fix compilation and behavioral regressions module by module.
Use embedded/in-memory test infrastructure (embedded Kafka, embedded Rabbit/Qpid or mocks, embedded Redis) for integration tests to keep the build self-contained.
assumptions: One senior developer (the estimator) performs all work, already familiar with Spring XD, Spring Cloud Stream, Spring Integration, and Maven; no onboarding or ramp-up time is required.
A workday equals 8 productive hours and excludes organizational overhead such as meetings, vacations, and support duties.
Existing source code for the Kafka and Rabbit modules in the XD repository and the header-enricher in the modules repository is available, builds, and has passing tests before migration.
Build infrastructure (Maven/Gradle CI jobs, artifact repositories) already exists and only needs incremental configuration changes.

Effort includes implementation, unit and integration tests, and developer-level documentation; it excludes formal QA cycles, external code review wait time, release management, and deployment to production.
A CF test foundation or suitable mocks are available for testing the refactored CF deployer; no live Cloud Foundry environment provisioning is included.
The target Spring Framework generation is the 4.x/4.2 line (as implied by U8), so Java 8 is the baseline and no Spring Framework 6 / Java 17 migration is in scope despite the introductory text.
Only Kafka and Rabbit sinks are migrated (U1, U2); the corresponding source-side modules are out of scope for this increment.
Hadoop distribution support (U6) is limited to build/classpath wiring for the major distributions, not to functional certification against live Hadoop clusters.
No third-party approvals, security audits, or license reviews are required beyond standard practice.

activities.activity_description: Analyze the eight user stories, review existing XD module code and s-c-s binder SPI, define target module structure, multi-binder configuration model, external override file format, and CF deployer adapter design; produce a short design note used to guide implementation.

activities.activity_name: U1: Migrate Kafka sink module to s-c-s repository
activities.activity_description: Move the Kafka sink from XD to the s-c-s repository: create the new Maven module, refactor packages and configuration to the Spring Cloud Stream model, implement the sink against the Kafka binder, port metadata/options, adapt the build, and port/add unit and integration tests using embedded Kafka.

activities.activity_name: U2: Migrate Rabbit sink module to s-c-s repository
activities.activity_description: Move the Rabbit sink from XD to the s-c-s repository analogous to A3: new Maven module, package/config refactoring to the Spring Cloud Stream model, Rabbit binder-based sink implementation, option metadata, build integration, and unit/integration tests (reusing patterns established in A2).

activities.activity_name: U3: Multi-binder support for module channels
activities.activity_description: Design and implement support for different binder types per channel: binder factory/registry creating and caching binder instances (rabbit, redis, kafka), per-channel binder resolution via configuration properties, lifecycle handling, error handling, plus unit and integration tests covering mixed-binder pipelines.

Implement loading of an external YAML/properties override file that influences default module configurations, including overriding module resolution (e.g., alternate Maven coordinates); integrate with the module resolver and configuration precedence rules; add tests and sample override files.

activities.activity_name: U5: Refactor Cloud Foundry SPI deployer to CF java-client
activities.activity_description: Replace the existing CC SPI deployer internals with the CF Java Client: build an adapter encapsulating app push/status/delete operations, rework async handling and error mapping, retain the deployer SPI contract, and update/add unit and integration tests with mocked CF responses.

Add per-distribution Maven profiles and dependency management for the major Hadoop distributions, implement runtime wiring so the chosen distribution's client libraries land on the module classpath, document the selection mechanism, and add build-level verification tests.

activities.activity_name: U7: Move header-enricher into XD proper
activities.activity_description: Relocate the header-enricher module from the modules repository into XD proper: integrate it into the XD module registry as a built-in processor, adjust packaging and option metadata, port its tests, and update references.

activities.activity_name: U8: Upgrade to SI 4.2, Spring 4.2.1, and AMQP 1.5
activities.activity_description: Update dependency versions in the parent POM/BOM, resolve compilation errors, deprecations, and behavioral changes caused by Spring Integration 4.2, Spring Framework 4.2.1, and Spring AMQP 1.5, and run regression tests across affected modules.

Assemble representative streaming pipelines exercising the migrated sinks with mixed binders, external override files, and upgraded dependencies; execute end-to-end scenarios, fix integration defects, and verify the CF deployer and Hadoop classpath changes do not break existing flows.

Write developer/user documentation for the migrated modules, multi-binder configuration, external override file format, Hadoop distribution selection, and upgrade notes, including minimal working configuration samples.
Update CI jobs and build scripts for the new s-c-s modules, the relocated header-enricher, the Hadoop distribution profiles, and the upgraded dependency set; verify clean, reproducible builds.
